correctness.rationale: PASS: Each marginal record probability is 1/i or 1/j. For i<j condition on unordered values of first i positions: the event B_j requires j to lie in suffix (because j>i); A_i depends only on the independent order of the prefix and is 1/i conditionally. For i>j condition instead on positions of values 1..j: B_j depends on their ordering, while A_i sees a larger value in first i and depends only on complementary values, giving independent conditioned indicators. At i=j, the only conditional overlap is when first i values are exactly 1..i, an event probability 1/binom(n,i); then A_i=B_i marks the event pi(i)=i, adding conditional variance (i-1)/i^2. Total covariance is exactly delta_ij*(i-1)/(i^2 binom(n,i)); summing yields 1/n+1/(2n^2)+O(n^-3) and correlation ~1/(n log n). Fully independent exact enumeration n<=7 of inverse words and both flag vectors checked all n^2 entries including n=1; finite tests are not the proof.
